policy.purpose: Registry for lawful public television, public-access, government, educational, FAST, and free-to-air provider integrations.
requirements: Provider must expose an official or otherwise authorized playback source.
Geographic and platform restrictions must be respected.
No credential bypass, DRM circumvention, scraped private feeds, or unauthorized rebroadcasting.
Embedding or playback must comply with the provider's terms and applicable rights.

providerClasses.name: Public Broadcaster
providerClasses.description: National, regional, state, municipal, educational, or community public broadcasters.

providerClasses.name: Public Access
providerClasses.description: Community and municipal public, educational, and governmental access channels.

providerClasses.name: Free-to-Air
providerClasses.description: Authorized over-the-air services made available through official digital feeds or tuner adapters.

providerClasses.name: FAST
providerClasses.description: Free ad-supported streaming television providers with authorized integration paths.
